title: ResearchCasePackage v2
description: A domain-neutral immutable package for one hard research or major project problem, binding exactly one hash-pinned task, at least one hash-pinned run, independently nullable member arrays of claims, evidence, observations, and analyses, plus the Phase 4 audit fields: problem signature, input/output and intermediate artifact manifests, decision timeline, open questions, environment, privacy review, export mode, eligibility, source, and backward lineage (ADR-0007 decision 2). Membership closure, pin agreement, and duplicate detection are enforced by graph verification, not here. Successor of research-case-package/v1 under the ADR-0004 compatibility policy: v1 remains frozen and valid forever; v2 records are new records with fresh case_id values, never in-place edits of v1 records.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact task record version.

task.description: Exactly one task: a single pinned reference object, not an array.

runs.description: At least one run of the packaged task, each hash-pinned.

claims.description: Member claims, each hash-pinned. May be an explicit empty array.

evidence.description: Member evidence records, each hash-pinned. May be an explicit empty array; when non-empty, the claims they support must also be members (closure, checked by graph verification).

observations.description: Member failure observations, each hash-pinned. May be an explicit empty array.

analyses.description: Member failure analyses, each hash-pinned. May be an explicit empty array.

summary.description: Short normalized statement of the problem shape, frozen before any retrieval or clustering use.

signature_sha256.description: Exact fingerprint of the normalized signature; the first tier of layered clustering (ADR-0007 decision 4).

facets.description: Optional structured facets of the signature. Content is data: the kernel stores and hashes it but never interprets it.

problem_signature.description: The frozen problem signature this case answers.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash binding the exact bytes.

locator.description: Optional safe relative path to the artifact. Secondary to the hash, never a replacement. Absolute paths, UNC, drive letters, and '..' are rejected.

inputs.description: Content hashes of the case inputs; at least one, so the case stays reproducible in principle.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash binding the exact bytes.

locator.description: Optional safe relative path to the artifact. Secondary to the hash, never a replacement. Absolute paths, UNC, drive letters, and '..' are rejected.

outputs.description: Content hashes of the case outputs; at least one.

io_manifest.description: Input and output content-hash manifest. Bytes themselves stay in the source project domain; only names, hashes, and optional safe relative locators are recorded.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash binding the exact bytes.

locator.description: Optional safe relative path to the artifact. Secondary to the hash, never a replacement. Absolute paths, UNC, drive letters, and '..' are rejected.

intermediate_manifest.description: Intermediate artifact manifest, same item shape as io_manifest entries. May be an explicit empty array.

entry.description: What was decided or done at this point, including rejected paths where relevant.

decision_timeline.description: Chronological decision log of the case; at least one entry.

open_questions.description: Questions left unresolved by this case. May be an explicit empty array.

details.description: Optional free-text environment detail (for example interpreter or dependency notes).

environment.description: The environment the packaged runs were produced in, bound to a version identifier.

privacy_review_status.description: Single-axis review state, widened from v1's fixed "pending" under the ADR-0004 decision 1 expansion path (a new schema version may extend the vocabulary). Export permission and export events remain orthogonal axes recorded by export records, never written back here.

export_mode.description: The export mode this package was prepared under (architecture vocabulary). A ceiling declaration, not a permission grant.

rights.description: Optional copyright or license note for case content originating outside this repository.

status.description: Outcome of the case eligibility gate (plan Phase 4 task 3).

reasons.description: Gate rationale. May be an explicit empty array when eligible; when ineligible the builder records each failed criterion here (builder-level discipline, M3).

eligibility.description: Eligibility gate record. Cases that are not reproducible, of unknown source, carrying unauthorized sensitive content, or reduced to a bare conclusion must be marked ineligible and must not enter shareable patterns.

project.description: Label of the source project or effort this case was captured from.

external_manifest_sha256.description: Optional content hash of an external manifest kept outside this repository; bytes are never copied (ADR-0005 decision 9 precedent).

source.description: Source lineage of the case: labels and content hashes only.

derived_from.description: Backward lineage to predecessor case packages, each hash-pinned. Targets research-case-package/v2 records only: graph verification reports a reference resolving to any other family (including v1) as cross_type_reference. May be an explicit empty array.
